records.title: Language Education Policy
records.publisher: Ministry of Education, Youth and Culture, Jamaica
records.summary: Sets direction for language issues in Jamaican education to improve language and literacy competencies, recognising Standard Jamaican English as the official language and Jamaican Creole as the most widely used. Copy held in the UWI library repository.
